1. **`farm_id`** — the system ID for Brookhaven Farm (e.g., something like `"farm_brookhaven"`, `"BH_farm"`, etc.)
2. **`field_id`** — the system ID for North Field (e.g., `"field_north"`, `"NF_001"`, etc.)
